steps.title: feel you can record
steps.body:
The drills are for feel you then *record*, not for playing live along a grid. Unquantized tape is where the OP-1 earns its keep next to a quantized Push.

These recipes put the Field's own sequencers to work: the finger sequencer for one-handed arrangement, the endless sequencer for odd-length motifs, and tombola for texture in the upper octave. Nothing here is scored.
